note: Card heights in CSS pixels at 900 wide, measured. The Design System pane sizes a card from the `viewport` in its @dsCard marker and clips anything taller, so a component absent from this file takes the pane's default and may lose its lower stories. HOW TO MEASURE: build the upload tree, serve it with _vendor/react.js + _vendor/react-dom.js beside it, load each card in an iframe 900 wide and TALLER than the card, then read the `#g` grid's height plus twice the body padding. Do not read documentElement.scrollHeight: it floors at the frame height, which silently reported a 167px card as 200. A layout sized in vh grows with the frame instead and cannot be measured this way — declare a height for it and let it fill.
